title: What’s Actually Killing Your Deal (Spoiler: It’s Not the Market)

 What’s Actually Killing Your Deal 
(Spoiler: It’s Not the Market)
Hi Sara,
Let’s play a little game.
What do you think kills more accounting firm deals than anything else?
A) Market conditions
B) Financing hurdles
C) Ghosting buyers
D) Lawyers being unreasonable and not knowing the first thing about business
If you guessed “all of the above,” congratulations, you’ve either bought a firm before or you’ve cried into a spreadsheet trying.
This week on the Dealmakers Podcast, I sat down with Jeff Bell from ABA Advisors, one of my favorite brokers in the game, to spill the tea on the five-headed beast that is: why deals fall apart.
Here’s what you’ll learn in this episode:
Why serious buyers need more than a LinkedIn profile and a dream

How some lawyers (no names… yet) singlehandedly nuke six-figure transactions

Why “buy, then hire a CPA” is the new “get rich quick” scam

The exact questions that make brokers say, “Yeah, no thanks”

We also dish on why you should never—seriously, never—try to buy a firm with zero money down unless you’re negotiating with someone’s estate.
If you’ve ever wondered what brokers and attorneys are really thinking when they vet your deal… this is the one to watch.
👉 Watch the full episode here on our YouTube channel: Dealmakers
To better deals (and fewer ghosts),

Sara Sharp
Partner, SK&S Law Group
Founder of Deal Academy

 For more helpful lessons from Deal Academy, check out our Dealmakers Youtube Channel where you'll find Sara's Weekly Wine Down, where she talks about what she's seen in the industry this week and interviews with M&A Experts and Dealmakers.
